August 12, 2026 
 
 
 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
SUB: EARNING CONFERENCE CALL RECORDING – FOR THE QUARTER ENDED JUNE 30, 
2026 
 
In furtherance of our letter dated August 03, 2026, informing the exchanges regarding conference 
call in respect of the Un-audited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter ended June 30, 
2026, we wish to inform that the said conference call was held today at 11:30 A.M. IST. 
 
The audio recording of the conference call has been hosted on the website of the Company and the 
link to access the said recording is as follows: https://www.tdps.co.in/investor-relations/financial-
results 
 
 
 
 
Kindly take the above on record. 
 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For TD Power Systems Limited
